explanation: The theorem is the extended (ENNReal) form of the defining inequality for the library's own gauge `ContinuousLinearMap.summingENorm` (the absolutely p-summing norm) with respect to the library's own `weakLpNorm` seminorm. Both `summingENorm` and `weakLpNorm` are defined in this library (TauCeti/Analysis/Normed/Operator/AbsolutelySumming.lean and TauCeti/Analysis/Normed/Lp/Weak.lean). I grepped Mathlib for `summing|Summing`, `absolutelySumming`, `pSumming`, `SummingNorm` and `weakLpNorm`: Mathlib has no notion of absolutely p-summing operators, no p-summing gauge/norm and no weak Lᵖ seminorm, so there is no Mathlib declaration that could state this result. The proof only uses the library's own `summingENorm_le_iff`, `weakLpNorm_comp_equiv` and Mathlib's `PiLp.norm_toLp_comp_equiv` (a reindexing glue lemma), so its mathematical content lies in the library's definitions.
